preferences.title: Fetch online animated album art
preferences.summary: If no local video exists, search artwork.m8tec.top using album artist and album, then cache the square video in plugin data. Off cancels pending downloads and uses local files only.

preferences.title: Video reflection
preferences.summary: Show a fading mirrored reflection of the live video below the cover. Applies immediately.

preferences.title: Pause 1 second between loops
preferences.summary: Hold the final video frame for one second before replaying. Turn off for no added pause. Applies immediately.

preferences.title: Video filename 1
preferences.summary: Checked in order beside the song. First existing file wins. Leave blank to skip. Include the extension.
